title: Renal Clearance and Albumin Binding May Distort Cross-Sectional Associations Between PFAS and Phenotypic Age Acceleration: analysis code
description: Analysis code and aggregate outputs for an NHANES 2005-2018 study of a four-chemical PFAS mixture (PFOS, PFOA, PFNA, PFHxS) and PhenoAge acceleration. The manuscript argument is that albumin binding and renal clearance create toxicokinetic overlap with the Levine PhenoAge algorithm, so cross-sectional PFAS-PhenoAge associations can be distorted, with CKD as an effect modifier. Public NHANES files are downloaded at runtime and are not redistributed.
